anomalies.observed: On the DISPLAY sheet the SSD1306 interface-select pin BS1 (U4 pin 11) is routed to the same vertical net as BS0 (pin 10) and BS2 (pin 12), which terminates at the GND symbol; no wire connects BS1 to the nearby VCC symbol.
anomalies.expected: BS1 must be tied to VCC so that the BS2/BS1/BS0 strapping is 0/1/0, the SSD1306's documented 2-wire I2C-mode configuration that the rest of the design assumes (D0 = DISP_SCL, D1/D2 = DISP_SDA).

evidence.quote: BS0 (pin 10) → GND; BS1 (pin 11) → VCC; BS2 (pin 12) → GND ... That BS2,BS1,BS0 = 0,1,0 strapping, together with D0→DISP_SCL and D1+D2 tied together →DISP_SDA, is the SSD1306's documented I2C-mode pin configuration
display.kicad_sch: BS0/BS1/BS2 pins (10/11/12) all terminate on the vertical wire that runs down to the GND symbol; BS1 is not routed to the VCC symbol.

anomalies.impact: The SSD1306 comes up strapped for a parallel interface instead of I2C, so it will not respond to the MCU's DISP_SCL/DISP_SDA signalling and the OLED stays blank.

parsed.summary: The design largely matches the specification (all passives, pull-ups, decoupling, TSC and NFC wiring check out), but the SSD1306 interface-select strapping on the display sheet appears to hold BS1 at GND instead of VCC, which would put the OLED in the wrong interface mode and leave it non-functional.
